review_evidence: README identifies Thales as a TypeScript-to-Lean 4 compiler and points to its Lean-visible semantics, refinement types, runtime, and IEEE-754 boundary axioms.
Direct inspection of Thales/TS/Runtime.lean found reusable definitions, inductive types, theorems, axioms, reflection interfaces, and JavaScript semantic operations that must remain searchable.
Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found only package options, external dependencies, Lean library roots, executable target, and test-library target.

rules.content_invariant: The exact lakefile contains only Lake package/dependency/target configuration. All compiler AST/parser/typechecker/emitter code, runtime definitions and axioms, generated-code interfaces, and tests remain retained in Thales/** and Test/**.
evidence: lakefile.lean imports Lake, sets package options, declares batteries/Regex dependencies, and declares Thales, ThalesRuntime, thales, and ThalesTest targets; it contains no TypeScript semantics, emitted-language definitions, theorems, or proof interfaces.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact Lake build/dependency configuration so build-target vocabulary does not occupy primary formalization search.

summary: Retain the TypeScript-to-Lean compiler, runtime semantics, and tests; exclude only the exact Lake build configuration.
